claims.claim: Multipliers cache identyczne miedzy modelami: 1.25x 5m write, 2x 1h write, 0.1x read (90% discount)
claims.citation: Multipliers per cache operation - uniwersalne. Identyczne miedzy wszystkimi modelami: 5-minute cache write 1.25x, 1-hour cache write 2x, Cache read (hit) 0.1x (90% discount).

claims.claim: Base input pricing kwiecien 2026: Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7 $5, Sonnet 4.6 $3, Haiku 4.5 $1 / MTok
claims.citation: Pelna oficjalna tabela: Opus 4.7/4.6/4.5 $5/MTok, Sonnet 4.6/4.5/4 $3/MTok, Haiku 4.5 $1/MTok.
Observation: Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7 zmniejszyl sie 3x vs Opus 4/4.1 (z $15 na $5). To sam w sobie ogromna wiadomosc dla zespolow heavy-Opus.

claims.claim: Break-even 5m cache: po 1 hit. Math: 2500 extra tokens za write < 9000 saved tokens za read
claims.citation: Break-even: po 1 hit (2500 extra na write < 9000 saved na read).

claims.claim: Break-even 1h cache: po 2 hitach. 2*9000 saved = 18000 > 10000 extra za 1h write
Du'An Lightfoot concrete case: $720/m -> $72/m, 81251 tokens video metadata, 100 requests/day = 90% savings, $648/miesiac
claims.citation: Du'An Lightfoot (labeveryday / Medium, 2025): Pre-cache: 81251 * $3 / 1M = $0.244 per request = $732/miesiac. Post-cache: $2.72/day = ~$72. Savings: $720 -> $72 = 90% reduction, $648/miesiac.

claims.claim: Claude Code 100-turn Opus session: $50-100 pre-cache -> $10-19 post-cache (96% hit rate) = 80% savings
claims.citation: Pre-cache: 100 turns: $9 input tokens + output costs = $50-100 total. Post-cache (96% hit rate): $1.3 input tokens + output = $10-19 total. Savings: $50-100 -> $10-19 = ~80% reduction.

claims.claim: Pricing multipliers stackuja: Batch 50% * Cache Read 10% = 5% of base input (95% total discount)
claims.citation: These multipliers stack with other pricing modifiers, including the Batch API discount and data residency. Batch + 5m cache read dla Sonnet 4.6: $3 * 0.5 * 0.1 = $0.15 / MTok (95% discount).

claims.claim: Data residency US-only = 1.1x mnoznik - aplikuje sie do WSZYSTKICH kategorii (input, output, cache write, read)
claims.citation: Data residency: For Claude Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, newer models, specifying US-only inference via inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads.

claims.claim: Fast mode (Opus 4.6 only) 6x base premium, stack z cache multiplier = $3/MTok cache read on Fast
claims.citation: Fast Mode + 5m cache read dla Opus 4.6: $30 * 0.1 = $3 / MTok (10% of fast mode base).

claims.claim: Long context 1M tokens at standard pricing dla Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7 i Sonnet 4.6 - cache savings zachowane
claims.citation: Claude Opus 4.7, 4.6 i Sonnet 4.6 maja full 1M token context window AT STANDARD PRICING. Implikacja dla caching: cache stays valuable nawet w 1M-token context.

claims.claim: Anthropic vs OpenAI vs Google: Anthropic 90% savings read, OpenAI 50%, Google 75% ale billed per minute storage
claims.citation: Porownanie: Anthropic Explicit cache_control 0.1x read, 1.25x/2x write. OpenAI Automatic >1024 tokens 0.5x read, 0% write. Google Gemini Explicit cachedContents API 0.25x read, 0% write (billed storage/minute).

claims.claim: Anthropic wymaga PAY FOR WRITE - nie ma 'automagic free cache' jak u OpenAI
claims.citation: Anthropic ma najwieksze savings na read (90% vs 50% OpenAI) ale jedyny wymaga PAY FOR WRITE upfront.

claims.claim: Opus 4.7 tokenizer moze uzyc 35% wiecej tokenow - zaloz 35% bufor w token budget
claims.citation: Opus 4.7 uses a new tokenizer compared to previous models, contributing to its improved performance on a wide range of tasks. This new tokenizer may use up to 35% more tokens for the same fixed text.

claims.claim: Anti-patterns gdzie cache KOSZTUJE WIECEJ: single-shot request, prefix ponizej minimum, high-churn prefix, spread sesji >5m
claims.citation: When cache NIE sie oplaca: Single-shot request, Prefiks ponizej minimum, Wysoki churn rate, Session lifetime < 5m and requests > 5 minutes apart.
claims.source_location: section: Details, 9. When cache NIE sie oplaca

claims.claim: Output tokens NIE sa cachowane - tylko input. Dlugi output nadal kosztuje full rate.
claims.citation: Nie zapomnij ze output tokens NIE sa cachowane. Cache dziala TYLKO na input. Dlugi output nadal kosztuje full rate.

claims.claim: Effective cost formula: per request uwzgledniaj input_tokens, cache_read * 0.1x, cache_creation 5m * 1.25x, 1h * 2x
claims.citation: Cost per request: effective_cost = (input_tokens + cache_read*0.1 + cache_creation_5m*1.25 + cache_creation_1h*2.0) * base_rate / 1M.

claims.claim: Alert jezeli cache_hit_ratio < 0.5 przez 3+ requesty w rzad - prawdopodobny invalidation trigger
claims.citation: Alert jezeli cache_hit_ratio < 0.5 przez 3+ requesty w rzad - cos psuje cache (prawdopodobnie invalidation trigger).
